# Financer Car Rental Jaipur

> Financer is a Jaipur-focused self-drive car rental website with 13 cars, 24-hour plans, 300 km included, flexible pickup locations, and Rajasthan road-trip planning. Rentals do not include a chauffeur. Availability, KYC and deposit are confirmed before payment.

The website serves travellers looking to rent a car without a driver in Jaipur. Core pickup areas include Jaipur Airport, Jaipur Railway Station, Vaishali Nagar, Mansarovar, Jagatpura and Sindhi Camp. Content is written for practical trip planning and should not replace current road signs, official destination rules or live navigation.

Business details: Financer Car Rental is owned by Sachin Jaat and based in Durgapura, Jaipur. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 96021 11420. Email: sachinjaat2111@gmail.com. Service area: Jaipur. Open 24 hours, 7 days a week.
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/say_dev_vicky/

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://financercarrental.in/): Self-drive overview, fleet, pickup search and popular Rajasthan drives.
- [Self-drive car rental Jaipur](https://financercarrental.in/self-drive-car-rental-jaipur): How booking, KYC, handover, deposits and kilometre plans work.
- [Cars](https://financercarrental.in/cars): Current example fleet with starting prices and specifications.
- [Jaipur pickup locations](https://financercarrental.in/pickup-locations): Airport, railway station and neighbourhood-specific pickup guidance.
- [Road trips from Jaipur](https://financercarrental.in/locations): Destination guides with distance, timing, route and safety notes.
- [Booking request](https://financercarrental.in/booking): Request availability; no payment is taken on the form.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://financercarrental.in/faq): Documents, fuel, deposits, kilometre limits, outstation travel and support.
- [Rental terms](https://financercarrental.in/terms): Eligibility, booking confirmation, deposits, vehicle use, fuel, incidents, cancellation and privacy terms.
- [Contact](https://financercarrental.in/contact): Jaipur support options and pickup hubs.

## Jaipur and nearby drives

- [Amer Fort](https://financercarrental.in/locations/amer-fort): Half-day heritage drive around 11 km from central Jaipur.
- [Nahargarh Fort](https://financercarrental.in/locations/nahargarh-fort): Aravalli hill and sunset drive around 20 km from central Jaipur.
- [Pushkar](https://financercarrental.in/locations/pushkar): One- or two-day lake-town drive around 145 km from Jaipur.
- [Ajmer](https://financercarrental.in/locations/ajmer): Full-day culture and lakeside drive around 135 km from Jaipur.
- [Sambhar Salt Lake](https://financercarrental.in/locations/sambhar-lake): Open-landscape day drive around 80 km from Jaipur.
- [Ranthambore](https://financercarrental.in/locations/ranthambore): Two- or three-day trip around 190 km from Jaipur; private cars do not replace authorised safari vehicles in restricted park areas.
